description: Official WCE Sangli social-media profiles. Ingested into the knowledge base by scripts/refresh_kb.py as one retrievable chunk per entry (doc_type 'social'). Verified against the college website footer and official accounts; update when profiles change.

entries.description: Official Instagram account of Walchand College of Engineering, Sangli — campus life, events, notices and student activities.
Official Facebook page of Walchand College of Engineering, Sangli — announcements, news and events.
Official LinkedIn company page of Walchand College of Engineering, Sangli — placements, achievements and professional updates.
Media WCE — YouTube channel of Walchand College of Engineering, Sangli, for educational videos and institute information.
The official WCE website lists Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube as the college's social-media channels. No X (Twitter) account is listed as official, so do not link to unverified accounts.
